descending.description: True if the sort is descending. (The default is ascending.)

nullsReversed.description:
True if nulls sort the opposite of the default of last for ascending and first for descending

Note that the sense of #nullsReversed is opposite to {@link Val#compareValues Val's} `nullIsGreater`.

opClass.description: Specifies the operator class for the field.

expression.description: Specifies the expressions to be applied on the field.

title: Represents the field or column on which the index applies.
